name: appcreator
label: App Creator
description: Describe an app in a sentence and a model writes its page: it is created as a real feature app at /<name>, appears in Apps, and can be a dashboard tab. The page is told to read live endpoints and never invent data, and the result is checked for the signs of a fake before it is called finished. The same page lists every app; click one to open it in the chat for changes, or remove it (removal goes to the trash).

steps: Open Apps > App Creator. Say what the app should show and why, pick the model, and create. It writes modules\<name>\: a manifest and a page, nothing else. A model that is not installed is an error rather than a silent fallback, and hand off sends the draft to a second model for review.

The prompt carries the real endpoints - WhatsApp, Microsoft 365, weather, Plex/UniFi, media, notes, memories, runs, routines, daybook, reading list, ops, watchtower - and a rule not to invent anything. A page that needs something no endpoint has must say so on screen. If you want a different source, name it in the sentence so the model knows which route to read.

The result is checked before it is called finished. If the page never calls an endpoint, or uses Math.random(), or contains Alice/Bob-style sample names, the status says 'NOT reading real data' and lists why. The app is still created so you can fix it.

Click the app in the list: Chat opens with its absolute folder and a prompt to read the files. Ask for the change you want ('read /api/modules/whatsapp/chats and show unread counts') and send; nothing changes until you do. Removing an app moves its folder to workspace\.trash.
fixes: The new app shows made-up messages or numbers

That was the old behaviour when the model had no data source: it filled the page with Math.random() activity. Creation now warns when it spots that, and the prompt names the real endpoints. Recreate it with the source in the sentence, or open it in Chat and ask for the specific route (docs/ADDING_APPS.md has the endpoint catalogue).
The app is created but a panel is empty or red

The page is calling an endpoint that is not answering - usually a service that is not signed in or not running (Microsoft 365, WhatsApp bridge, Plex). The panel should show that error; if it shows nothing at all, ask in Chat to render the error object the route returned.
There is no tab for the app after creating it
The tab bar is built on page load: reload the dashboard. An app created with pane off opens in its own window from Apps instead, and Settings > Features has its toggle either way.
The model wrote a page but it looks like the old one

The model's draft is what gets installed; the review step only runs with hand off ticked. Open the app in Chat and ask for the layout change, or recreate with a more specific sentence (say the panels, the order and the data each one reads).
